title: Ines and the Orchard
author: Vesper Okafor
blurb: Mirabel Delacroix, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
